A VPN (virtual private network) is a service that creates a private, scrambled link between your device and the internet.

Your traffic goes through a remote computer run by the VPN company. Websites see that location instead of yours, and your internet provider can't read what you do.

People use it for safer public Wi-Fi, more privacy, or reaching work files from home. It doesn't make you fully anonymous, and you have to trust the VPN company.

lastReply:
A VPN is a private tunnel between your phone or laptop and the internet. Everything you send goes through it in scrambled form, so others can't read it.

Websites see the VPN's address instead of yours, which hides your location. On public Wi-Fi, it also stops strangers from snooping on what you do.

It doesn't make you fully anonymous. The VPN company can still see your activity, so pick one you trust.

VPN ek private raasta hai jo aapke phone ya laptop ko internet se jodta hai. Aapka data scrambled hokar jaata hai, isliye doosre use padh nahi sakte.

Websites ko aapka asli location nahi, VPN ka address dikhta hai. Public Wi-Fi par bhi koi aapki activity jhaank nahi sakta.

Lekin VPN aapko poori tarah anonymous nahi banata. VPN company aapki activity dekh sakti hai, isliye bharosemand company hi chuniye.

वीपीएन एक निजी रास्ता है जो आपके फ़ोन या लैपटॉप को इंटरनेट से जोड़ता है। आपका डेटा कोड में बदलकर जाता है, इसलिए दूसरे उसे पढ़ नहीं सकते।

वेबसाइटों को आपकी असली जगह नहीं, वीपीएन का पता दिखता है। सार्वजनिक वाई-फ़ाई पर भी कोई आपकी गतिविधि नहीं देख पाता।

लेकिन वीपीएन आपको पूरी तरह छिपा नहीं देता। वीपीएन कंपनी आपकी गतिविधि देख सकती है, इसलिए भरोसेमंद कंपनी ही चुनें।
